description: Replace naive calendar-day addition with business-day addition that skips weekends and is exact for any starting weekday
prompts: dates.rb's add_business_days(start, n) just does `start + n` - it counts weekends as business days (Date#+ adds calendar days). Implement it properly: n=0 returns start unchanged (even if start itself falls on a weekend); for n>0, step forward day by day, skipping Saturday and Sunday, until n business days have been counted, then return that date. It must be exact for any starting weekday and correctly cross month/year boundaries - do not use an approximation formula like `n + 2*(n/5)` calendar-days shortcut, it gives the wrong answer depending on which weekday `start` falls on.

setup_files.dates.rb:
require "date"

def add_business_days(start, n)
  start + n
end

reference_solution.dates.rb:
require "date"

def add_business_days(start, n)
  return start if n == 0

  current = start
  counted = 0
  while counted < n
    current += 1
    counted += 1 unless current.saturday? || current.sunday?
  end
  current
end

files.dates.rb:
require "date"

def add_business_days(start, n)
  return start if n == 0

  weeks, remainder = n.divmod(5)
  calendar_days = weeks * 7 + remainder
  start + calendar_days
end

name: add_ruby_business_day_date_math

test_setup_files.dates_hidden_test.rb:
require "minitest/autorun"
require "date"
require_relative "dates"

class DatesTest < Minitest::Test
  def test_zero_returns_start_unchanged
    d = Date.new(2024, 6, 1) # Saturday
    assert_equal d, add_business_days(d, 0)
  end

  def test_friday_plus_one_skips_weekend
    friday = Date.new(2024, 5, 31)
    assert_equal Date.new(2024, 6, 3), add_business_days(friday, 1)
  end

  def test_monday_plus_five_lands_next_monday
    monday = Date.new(2024, 5, 27)
    assert_equal Date.new(2024, 6, 3), add_business_days(monday, 5)
  end

  def test_crosses_month_and_year_boundary
    friday = Date.new(2024, 12, 27)
    assert_equal Date.new(2025, 1, 1), add_business_days(friday, 3)
  end

  def test_starting_on_a_weekend_still_counts_correctly
    saturday = Date.new(2024, 6, 1)
    assert_equal Date.new(2024, 6, 3), add_business_days(saturday, 1)
  end
end
